You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); dom=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hs=[i for i,r_ in enumerate(g) if len(set(r_))==1 and r_[0]!=dom]
    vs=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(H)) and g[0][j]!=dom]
    scol=set(g[h][0] for h in hs)|set(g[0][v] for v in vs)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    rowbands=[]
    bnds=[(0,hs[0])] + [(hs[i],hs[i+1]) for i in range(len(hs)-1)] + [(hs[-1],H)] if hs else [(0,H)]
    colbands=[(0,vs[0])] + [(vs[i],vs[i+1]) for i in range(len(vs)-1)] + [(vs[-1],W)] if vs else [(0,W)]
    for a,b in rowbands:
        for c,d in colbands:
            cnt=Counter()
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(c,d):
                    if g[i][j] not in scol: cnt[g[i][j]]+=1
            if not cnt: continue
            minor=min(cnt,key=cnt.get); mc=cnt[minor]
            col=minor if mc%2==1 else dom   # try: odd count -> fill with marker
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(c,d):
                    if g[i][j] not in scol: out[i][j]=col
    return out

import os,re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cc=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hs=[i for i,r_ in enumerate(g) if len(set(r_))==1 and r_[0]!=bg]
    vs=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] for i in range(H)) and g[0][j]!=bg]
    scol={g[h][0] for h in hs}|{g[0][v] for v in vs}
    marks=[k for k,n in cc.items() if k not in (bg,) and k not in scol]
    mc=min(marks,key=lambda k:cc[k])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    rowbands=[(0,hs[0])] + [(hs[i],hs[i+1]) for i in range(len(hs)-1)] + [(hs[-1],H)] if hs else [(0,H)]
    colbands=[(0,vs[0])] + [(vs[i],vs[i+1]) for i in range(len(vs)-1)] + [(vs[-1],W)] if vs else [(0,W)]
    tot=sum(1 for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==mc)
    for a,b in rowbands:
        for c,d in colbands:
            n=sum(1 for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if g[i][j]==mc)
            col=mc if (tot-n)%2==1 else bg
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(c,d):
                    if g[i][j]==mc: out[i][j]=col
    return out
print('pair1:',f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('pair2:',f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    hs=[i for i,r_ in enumerate(di) if len(set(r_))==1 and r_[0]!=bg]

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
di=G['Demo pair 2 input']; do=G['Demo pair 2 output']
H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
cc=Counter(x for r_ in di for x in r_); print('counter',dict(cc))
hs=[i for i,r_ in enumerate(di) if len(set(r_))==1 and r_[0]!=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]]
vs=[j for j in range(W) if all(di[i][j]==di[0][j] for i in range(H)) and di[0][j]!=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]]
print('hs',hs,'vs',vs)
# marker color: non-bg, non-sep
sep=set(di[h][0] for h in hs)|set(di[0][v] for v in vs)
marks=sorted([k for k,n in cc.items() if k not in (cc.most_common(1)[0][0],sep)])
print('markers',marks)
